title: error text starts with response code: '441 441 Missing Message-ID header'
description: In lifecycle.rs extract_post_metadata, three error messages are constructed as: Response::new(441, "441 Missing Message-ID header"). The numeric code appears both as the response code and again in the text. On the wire this produces '441 441 Missing Message-ID header'. Confusing for any client or user reading logs or the NNTP session transcript. What would make it clear: remove the '441 ' prefix from the text strings — Response::new(441, "Missing Message-ID header").
